Inventory Dashboard

ℹ️ How are Sufficient / Watch / Caution / Urgent / Out of Stock calculated?

▸ Click to expand

Day of Supply = Actual Inventory Qty ÷ Average Daily Out. Uses the last 7 days' average Out if there's been any movement in that window; otherwise falls back to the 30-day average. If there's been no Out at all in either window, the item can't be "running out" from current demand, so it's treated as Sufficient no matter how low the qty is.

LevelRule

The day counts above come from the Warning Threshold dropdown (currently set below) — change it and this list updates too. Items flagged Make to Order are excluded from this classification entirely: they're meant to sit near zero stock between orders, so a low quantity isn't a warning for them.

📋 Planned Ingredient Demand (Unconfirmed Production Runs)

Total ingredients needed for every Production Run that's still Planned (from the Create tab), converted from the recipe's kg amounts into stock units. Flags anything you don't have enough of on hand yet.

IngredientCurrent StockPlanned DemandRemaining After DemandShortfallRuns Short Starting
No unconfirmed production runs use flour ingredients right now.

📅 Weekly Projected Usage vs Current Stock

Planned Usage only counts Planned runs (not yet Confirmed) — a Confirmed run has already deducted its flour from Current Stock at confirm time, so counting it again here would double-subtract it. Current Stock is today's live figure — for a future week, Remaining first subtracts every Planned run scheduled between now and the start of that week (shown as "used by earlier runs" below, so paging forward doesn't reuse the same stock twice), then adds every still-Pending Expected Delivery (dates shown below; a red "overdue" tag means it hasn't arrived yet even though its expected date already passed), then subtracts this week's own Planned usage. Short Starting walks this week's Planned runs day by day to show exactly when — and by how much — the shortfall would start. Status uses each ingredient's own Reorder Level: Short if that running total still can't cover this week's usage, Low if it covers usage but ends the week at or below Reorder Level, otherwise OK.

Data Backup

Download every table as one JSON file — keep it somewhere safe (e.g. a shared drive) in case anything ever needs to be restored.

Full Backup

Covers every table in the app, grouped here for quick reference:

  • Inventory — items, opening balances, in/out history, orders, duplicated-item mappings
  • Sachets & components — sachets, sachet recipes, sachet in/out history
  • Production scheduling & staffing — lines, products, production runs, employees, employee leave, Flour Mixing Room / Packaging Center staff & positions, process steps & assignments
  • Flour — ingredients, in/out history, expected deliveries, recipes
  • Sauce production — locations, allergens, sauces, ingredients, recipes, in/out history, schedule
  • System — user profiles, role requests, role permissions, CSV import log

Restoring

This app doesn't restore a backup automatically — that's intentional, to avoid accidentally overwriting live data. If you ever need to restore, open the JSON file and re-insert the rows you need through Supabase's Table Editor, or ask for help turning it back into SQL.
